# SquatSense — llms.txt

> SquatSense is a free, AI-powered 30-second squat game. It uses real-time camera-based pose detection to score your form and count reps. Play solo on any device or compete on gym/office kiosk leaderboards. Part of the Kinely ecosystem (kinely.ai).

## Product
- Free 30-second squat blitz game
- Real-time AI pose detection via camera (no hardware/wearables)
- Scores depth, stability, tempo for every rep
- Personal play mode (any device) + Arena/Kiosk mode (gym/office TV)
- Movement Points ranking system (Bronze → Silver → Gold → Elite)
- Team leaderboards for offices and gyms

## Technology
- Client-side MediaPipe Tasks Vision for pose detection
- WebSocket real-time biomechanics processing
- Next.js 16 + React 19 frontend
- FastAPI + PostgreSQL backend (shared with FreeForm Fitness)

## Ecosystem
SquatSense is one of three products in the Kinely ecosystem:
- **Kinely** (kinely.ai) — the AI operating system for fitness
- **TraqGym** (traqgym.com) — gym management + AI agents
- **FreeForm Fitness** (freeformfitness.ai) — AI strength training with per-rep biomechanics
- **SquatSense** (squatsense.ai) — the 30-second squat game (this product)

## Company
Kinely · Mumbai, India · Early-stage, first paying customer live
Founded by Robin Carruthers (CEO) and Amit Kumar Das (CTO)
